text.content: Make a list of interests. How many do you know? You have one minute.
Check (/) the questions you can ask when someone is speaking too fast or
you want someone to repeat something. You have one minute.
Can you say that more slowly, please?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
Could you say that again, please?
Say the names of sports and exercises. Can your partner say the correct verb?
Describe or act out an interest or a sport, but don’t say its name. Can your partner
guess what it is? Take turns. You and your partner have two minutes.
A: I write online every day. Other people read my writing
B: Do you write a blog?
Who has unusual interests? Go online and find someone
with one of these interests. Then write about it.
A woman in the U.S. has ducks
has an unusual pet collects something
makes something plays an unusual sport
